subject: Invitation to Attend Annual Company Conference
body: Dear Team, It's that time of the year again! We are thrilled to invite you to our annual company conference, where we will celebrate our achievements, discuss upcoming projects, and network with colleagues. The event will take place on October 15th at the Grand Hotel Ballroom. Please RSVP by September 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
